title: Reinstatement of a Named Non-Owner Policy Cancelled for Nonpayment
content:
## Who may be reinstated
Only a Named Non-Owner Policy term whose cancellation reason is nonpayment can be reinstated (read from the term's recorded cancellation reason).

## Reinstatement without lapse
A reinstatement without lapse applies only when a mailed payment of at least the minimum due was postmarked on or before the cancellation effective date and posted no later than the postmark receipt days after it, or the cancellation came from a company posting error; it restores the term from the cancellation effective date with no fee and no lapse.

## Reinstatement with lapse
Otherwise every past-due amount on the billing plan must have been paid after the cancellation, and:

1. **Window.** A reinstatement with lapse is processed no later than the package's reinstatement window days after the cancellation effective date. Calendar days are counted from the cancellation effective date as day 0, so the last day of the window is the cancellation effective date plus the window days.
2. **Statement of No Loss.** A Statement of No Loss attesting no loss must be on file, and the reinstatement is processed no later than the Statement of No Loss age limit in calendar days after the Statement of No Loss was signed. Calendar days are counted from the signing date as day 0, and the reinstatement must be processed on or before the signing date plus the allowed days.
3. **Count.** The term must have fewer reinstatements with a lapse already than the package's maximum, counted as the reinstatement fees booked on the term within the whole current term.

The reinstatement effective date is the later of the posting date of the completing payment and the statement signing date, plus the reinstatement effective offset days; the lapse runs from the cancellation effective date to the day before.

## Re-written premium
~~Re-written premium is the cancellation return premium multiplied by the days from the reinstatement effective date to expiration and divided by that return's recorded days, rounded to the cent.~~ This clause is **no longer in force** as a general rule. Current basis: the premium re-written on a reinstatement with a lapse is worked out under the company's current re-write rule for such reinstatements; on a reinstatement without lapse the re-written premium is still the cancellation return premium multiplied by the days from the reinstatement effective date to expiration and divided by that return's recorded days, rounded to the cent.

## Certificates
An SR-22 or FR-44 Operator certificate whose SR-26 was already transmitted is re-established only by a new filing.

## Boundary cases (abstract)
| Processing date | Window test |
|---|---|
| cancellation effective date plus the window days | within the window |
| one day later | outside the window |

| Statement signed on day S, processing on | Statement test |
|---|---|
| S plus the allowed days | met |
| S plus the allowed days plus one | not met |

superseded_clauses: Re-written premium is the cancellation return premium multiplied by the days from the reinstatement effective date to expiration and divided by that return's premium_days, rounded to the cent.
